integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 高质量二次元插画被赋予生命，保持 <Picture 1> 的线面、灰白主色、唯一的蓝紫高光，以及扁平绘画质感，不要三维写实重绘。开场完全沿用 <Picture 1>：同一张脸、同一银灰长发、同一双蓝紫色晶体虹膜、同一高领切面黑衣、同一蓝紫晶体耳坠、同一低机位胸像近景、同一失焦前景羽片和发亮灰白天空。人物身份、服装、配饰、构图和空间关系全程不变。镜头保持固定近景，仅以极小幅度、极慢速度轻微推近，不切换、不摇、不晃。0.00 秒她保持首帧姿态：3/4 侧面，下颌微抬，目光看向画面右前方，嘴唇闭合，表情冷静。一阵持续的侧风从画面右侧吹向左侧。银灰色长发整缕向左后方扬起，细碎碎发掠过颊侧和眉骨，发梢交错甩动后回落，再被下一阵风重新托起。左耳的层叠蓝紫晶体耳坠随发丝轻轻摆动，切面闪过短暂虹彩。高领黑衣的切面高光随呼吸和风微微游移，肩胸以很小幅度起伏一次完整呼吸。前景失焦的褐色羽片缓慢飘过镜头，有的从右下角进入、有的从左上角离开，始终保持虚焦。背景天光里的细碎亮斑缓慢漂移。约 1.8 秒她自然眨眼一次，眼睑完全合上再睁开，睁开后虹膜里的蓝紫晶体光点仍在。约 4.4 秒再缓慢眨眼一次，比上一次稍慢。全程不转头、不改五官结构、不张嘴、不说话，口型始终闭合。

overall_soundscape: 持续的中等侧风贯穿全片，发丝和衣料被风刮过时有细碎的布料与发丝声。失焦羽片偶尔轻轻擦过。能听见一次很轻的吸气和一次呼气。没有人声。

non_diegetic_music: 稀疏的低频合成垫底，速度很慢，几乎没有旋律，音量始终压在风声之下，结尾不渐强。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] High-quality 2D-animated illustration brought to life, preserving the linework, grey-and-white palette, isolated blue-violet highlights, and flat painted texture of <Picture 1>. Do not restyle it as live-action or 3D. The shot begins from <Picture 1> and fully preserves the same face, silver-grey windblown hair, crystalline blue-violet irises, high-collar faceted black garment, layered blue-violet crystal earring, low-angle bust close-up, out-of-focus foreground feathers, and bright grey-white sky. Identity, wardrobe, jewelry, composition, and spatial relationships stay identical throughout. The camera holds a static close shot and pushes in with very small amplitude at very slow speed, with no cut, pan, or shake. At 0.00 seconds she holds the first-frame pose: a three-quarter profile, chin slightly lifted, gaze toward the right of frame, lips closed, expression calm. A continuous side wind blows from screen right toward screen left. The long silver-grey hair streams backward and left, fine strands crossing the cheek and brow, tips interleaving, falling, then lifting again on the next gust. The stacked blue-violet crystal earring on the left ear sways with the hair and flashes a brief iridescent glint. Faceted highlights on the black collar shift slightly with breath and wind, and the shoulders and chest rise and fall through one full, small-amplitude breath. Out-of-focus brown feathers drift slowly across the lens, some entering from the lower right and some leaving at the upper left, staying soft. Tiny bright specks in the sky drift slowly. At about 1.8 seconds she blinks once, lids fully closing then opening, the blue-violet crystal points in the irises still visible afterward. At about 4.4 seconds she blinks again, slower than the first. She does not turn her head, change her facial structure, open her mouth, or speak; the lips stay closed through the last frame.

overall_soundscape: A continuous mid-strength side wind runs through the clip, with faint hair and fabric rustle as gusts pass. An out-of-focus feather occasionally brushes past. One light inhale and one exhale are audible. No voices.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse low synth pad at a very slow tempo, almost without melody, kept quieter than the wind, with no swell at the end.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 真人实拍古装剧，电影感，浅景深。开场完全沿用 <Picture 1>：同一张脸、同一发型头饰耳坠、同一身浅青绿色绣花襦裙、同一室内近景构图、同一柔光与虚化背景。人物位置、服装颜色、首饰和空间关系全程不变。镜头以小幅度、慢速轻微推近，不切换、不摇、不晃。0.00 秒时她保持首帧状态：眉心轻蹙，双眼睁大，视线略偏上对着镜头，上下唇分开约一两毫米，面颊干燥，没有泪。1.5 秒前仍停在这个发愣里，只有睫毛轻颤、呼吸微动。1.5 秒到 3.0 秒，眼神从发愣慢慢变软，嘴唇合拢，胸口起伏稍加重，仍看着镜头。3.0 秒到 4.5 秒，眼皮缓慢闭合，头轻轻低下半寸，嘴角极克制地往上弯成苦笑，下眼睑开始潮湿，一滴泪在左眼角聚起。4.5 秒到 6.00 秒，她重新抬眼看向镜头，双眼睁开但仍湿润；左颊一条清晰泪痕从眼角沿颧骨滑下，右颊几乎没有泪；嘴角保持含蓄浅笑，停在含泪浅笑的终态直到最后一帧。全程不说话，口型不张合出字。不要改脸，不要改发型服装，不要换成窗边侧脸或树叶光斑。

overall_soundscape: 安静的室内底噪贯穿全片，偶有极轻的衣料摩擦。能听见她细弱的吸气与一次轻轻吞咽。4 秒后左颊泪滑落时几乎没有声音。

non_diegetic_music: 一首缓慢的独奏钢琴，旋律克制、音与音之间留白很大，音量始终压在呼吸之下，结尾不渐强。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic period-drama close-up with shallow depth of field. The shot begins from <Picture 1> and fully preserves the woman's face, high bun, hair ornaments, jade-bead earrings, pale teal-green embroidered ruqun, white crossed collar, indoor close-up composition, soft interior light, and blurred corridor background. Identity, wardrobe, jewelry, and spatial relationships stay identical throughout. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed and never cuts, pans, or shakes. At 0.00 seconds she holds the first-frame state: brows faintly drawn, eyes wide, gaze slightly upward toward the lens, lips parted by one or two millimeters, cheeks dry, no tears. Through 1.5 seconds she remains in that stunned look, with only a lash tremor and a faint breath. From 1.5 to 3.0 seconds the stare softens, the lips close, and her breath deepens while she keeps looking at the camera. From 3.0 to 4.5 seconds the eyelids close slowly, the head dips by a small amount, the mouth corners lift into a restrained bitter smile, the lower lids grow wet, and a tear gathers at the left eye corner. From 4.5 to 6.00 seconds she lifts her gaze back to the lens, eyes open but still wet; a single clear tear tracks down the left cheek along the cheekbone while the right cheek stays almost dry; the mouth holds the small smile and settles on this wet-eyed expression through the last frame. She never speaks, and the mouth never forms words. Do not change the face, hairstyle, or costume, and do not switch to a window-side profile or leaf-shadow lighting.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room tone continues throughout, with occasional faint fabric rustle. A thin inhale and one small swallow are audible. The tear sliding down the left cheek after 4 seconds makes almost no sound.

non_diegetic_music: A slow solo-piano line with wide spaces between notes, kept quieter than her breathing, with no swell at the end.

prompt.zh: 以图2中的游戏角色作为人物身份与造型核心参考，以图1作为真人特写的构图、光影和质感参考，生成一张高质量写实真人风格的人像作品。保留图2角色的核心识别特征：年轻东方女性、黑色高束发、额前红色发带与金属饰件、英气但柔和的五官、黑红配色的古风武侠服饰、肩部装饰、红色飘带和精致古典细节。将角色整体真人化，皮肤呈现自然真实的纹理与细腻质感，五官比例更贴近真实人像，眼睛不要过于二次元夸张，头发要发丝分明、有自然光泽，服饰材质、刺绣、金属配饰和布料层次要真实可信。画面采用图1那样的近景特写构图，人物正面或微微正侧面，胸部以上构图，黑色或纯暗背景，具有高级人像摄影感。整体氛围保持东方古风、红黑金配色、精致华丽但不俗艳，兼具侠气、冷静、贵气和电影感。
prompt.en: Using the game character in Figure 2 as the core reference for identity and styling, and Figure 1 as a reference for real-person close-up composition, lighting, and texture, generate a high-quality, realistic, real-person style portrait. Retain the core identifying features of the character in Figure 2: a young East Asian woman, high black ponytail, red headband with metal ornaments on the forehead, heroic but soft facial features, black and red ancient martial arts attire, shoulder decorations, red ribbons, and delicate classical details. Humanize the character overall, with natural and realistic skin texture and delicate quality, facial proportions closer to a real person, eyes not overly exaggerated in an anime style, hair with distinct strands and natural luster, and realistic and believable clothing materials, embroidery, metal accessories, and fabric layers. The image should adopt a close-up composition like Figure 1, with the character facing forward or slightly to the side, framed from the chest up, against a black or pure dark background, possessing a high-end portrait photography feel. The overall atmosphere should maintain an oriental ancient style, black, red, and gold color scheme, exquisite and luxurious but not vulgar, combining heroism, calmness, nobility, and cinematic quality.

prompt.zh: 高空俯视视角，一幅极具东方武侠意境的黑白电影感画面。两名古代剑客站立在广阔的水面之上，彼此相隔遥远，持剑对峙。左下方是一名身穿深色长袍的剑客，动作更具进攻性，身体前倾，衣摆飞扬；右上方是一名身穿白色长袍的剑客，姿态平静克制，持剑平指前方。两人脚下的水面分别形成巨大旋转涡流，左侧为深色旋涡，右侧为浅色旋涡，二者在中央交汇融合，整体构成类似太极阴阳的抽象图案。水面纹理极其细密、流畅、连续，像丝绸般旋转，也像水墨笔触般扩散。两名人物都投下很长的阴影，增强戏剧感和张力。人物在画面中比例较小，环境占据大面积空间，突出天地辽阔、人物渺小与武道对决的宿命感。整体风格极简、肃杀、寂静，富有禅意、东方哲学意味和高级电影构图，超细节，强烈明暗对比，史诗感。
prompt.en: A dramatic top-down aerial view of two ancient swordsmen standing on a vast swirling water surface, facing each other in a tense duel. The image is monochrome black and white, highly cinematic and minimalistic. One dark-robed swordsman stands in the lower left, in a dynamic attacking stance with flowing garments; one white-robed swordsman stands in the upper right, calm and composed, pointing a sword forward. Beneath them, the water forms two giant swirling vortexes — a dark vortex on the left and a bright vortex on the right — merging in the center into a composition resembling a yin-yang symbol. The water texture is extremely fine, flowing, layered, and organic, like liquid silk or expressive ink-brush strokes. Both figures cast long dramatic shadows across the water. The characters are small within the frame, while the environment dominates the composition, creating a sense of vastness, stillness, tension, and Eastern philosophical symbolism. Ultra-detailed, high contrast, poetic wuxia aesthetic, zen atmosphere, epic cinematic composition.

prompt.zh:
典型的竖版人物海报构图。人物头部位于画面上半部，脸部大约占整个画面的核心 2/3，右侧保留了一定负空间。背景高度虚化，通过浅景深突出人物。东方古典审美 + 暗黑电影感的人像海报，主体是一位年轻女性的超近景侧脸肖像，画面整体带有明显的古风、玄幻和高级时尚摄影质感。
画面中的人物占据了绝大部分构图，脸部微微侧向右方，视线略微下垂、望向画面右侧。她的表情非常克制，没有明显微笑，呈现出一种冷静、疏离、忧郁又略带神秘感的情绪。五官被近距离突出表现，尤其是眼睛、鼻梁和嘴唇，具有很强的视觉焦点。
人物留着黑色长发，头发并不是规整盘起，而是呈现一种略微凌乱、湿润的状态。额前和脸颊周围散落着一些细碎发丝，部分发丝贴在皮肤上，使人物有一种刚经历雨水、雾气或者水汽环境后的感觉。头顶和侧面的头发在青绿色冷光照射下出现明显高光，因此发丝具有比较强的湿润光泽。
额头中央佩戴了一套非常精致的金属额饰／眉心坠饰。饰品由细金属链、小型珠宝、蓝绿色宝石和水滴形吊坠组成，中央吊饰垂落到眉心附近。耳部还能看到体积较大的金色耳饰，与整体服饰上的金色纹样呼应。首饰的风格介于古典宫廷、东方幻想和玄幻游戏角色设计之间。
她的妆容也非常突出。眼妆以金色、铜金色和深棕红色为主，眼皮及眼周带有明显的金属闪粉效果，眼尾细长，有轻微上扬感。脸颊和眼睛周围散落着大量细微金色亮点，看起来像金粉、星尘或者碎金。部分金色装饰甚至像液态金一样沿着面部形成细线。嘴唇则是偏自然的肉桂红、珊瑚红色调，表面带有湿润光泽。
人物的皮肤处理偏向高端时尚摄影式的细腻质感。鼻梁和右侧面部被一道明显的青白色冷光照亮，而左侧面部则处在比较深的阴影和暖金色环境光中。因此整张脸形成了比较典型的冷暖双色光对比：

* 画面右侧主要是青绿色、蓝绿色冷光；

* 左侧及眼妆、饰品位置则主要是金色、琥珀色暖光。

这种色彩组合让人物既有古典金饰的华丽感，又具有电影中夜景、雨夜或者水下场景般的幽暗氛围。
人物身上穿着黑色或极深墨绿色的古典服饰。肩颈附近可以看到比较厚重的衣领，上面有明显的金色卷草纹、刺绣或浮雕式装饰。由于画面采用近景，服装并没有完整展示，但从可见部分看，属于偏华丽、庄重的东方幻想服饰，而不是简单日常汉服。
背景基本完全虚化，主要由深黑、墨绿和蓝绿色组成。背景中散布着少量圆形光斑和颗粒状高光，进一步营造出潮湿、夜晚、森林、宫殿暗处或者幻想空间的感觉。画面中也漂浮着一些细小金色亮点，像萤火、星尘、金粉一样。
画面纯净没有文字
prompt.en:
A typical vertical portrait poster composition. The subject's head occupies the upper half of the frame, with the face filling roughly the central two-thirds of the image, and negative space preserved on the right side. The background is heavily blurred, using shallow depth of field to emphasize the subject. An Eastern classical aesthetic blended with dark cinematic portraiture — the subject is an extreme close-up profile of a young woman's face, conveying an overall sense of ancient fantasy and high-end fashion photography.

The figure dominates the composition, with the face turned slightly to the right, gaze gently lowered toward the right side of the frame. Her expression is highly restrained, without any obvious smile, projecting a calm, detached, melancholic, and subtly mysterious mood. Her facial features are rendered in close-up detail, especially the eyes, nose bridge, and lips, which create a strong focal point.

She has long black hair, not neatly arranged but rather in a slightly disheveled, damp state. Fine strands scatter across her forehead and around her cheeks, some clinging to her skin, giving the impression she has just been through rain, mist, or a humid environment. The hair on top and at the sides shows prominent highlights under a teal-green cool light, giving the strands a strong wet sheen.

At the center of her forehead sits an exquisite metal headpiece / brow ornament. It consists of fine metal chains, small jewels, blue-green gemstones, and a teardrop pendant, with the central ornament hanging down to near her brow. Large gold earrings are also visible at her ears, echoing the gold patterns on her garments. The jewelry style sits between classical court ornamentation, Eastern fantasy, and fantasy game character design.

Her makeup is equally striking. The eye makeup is dominated by gold, bronze-gold, and deep brownish-red tones, with pronounced metallic shimmer on the eyelids and around the eyes. Her eye corners are elongated with a slight upward tilt. Scattered across her cheeks and around her eyes are numerous fine golden flecks, resembling gold dust, stardust, or crushed gold. Some gold accents even trace fine lines along her face like liquid gold. Her lips are a natural cinnamon-red, coral hue with a moist gloss.

The skin is rendered with the refined texture of high-end fashion photography. Her nose bridge and the right side of her face are illuminated by a distinct cool bluish-white light, while the left side of her face falls into deeper shadow and warm golden ambient light. This creates a characteristic dual-tone lighting contrast across the face:

- The right side of the frame is dominated by cool teal and blue-green light;
- The left side, eye makeup, and jewelry area are mainly bathed in warm gold and amber light.

This color combination gives the figure both the opulence of classical gold ornaments and the shadowy, moody atmosphere of a night, rainy, or underwater cinematic scene.

She wears black or deep very-dark-green classical attire. Around the shoulders and neck, a heavier collar is visible, bearing clear gold scrollwork patterns, embroidery, or relief-style ornamentation. Since the shot is a close-up, the garments aren't fully shown, but what's visible suggests ornate, stately Eastern fantasy clothing rather than simple everyday hanfu.

The background is almost entirely blurred, composed mainly of deep black, dark green, and blue-green tones. Scattered throughout are a few circular bokeh spots and granular highlights, further evoking a sense of dampness, night, forests, shadowed palace interiors, or a fantasy space. Tiny golden highlights also float through the frame, like fireflies, stardust, or gold dust.

The image contains no text.

prompt.zh:
高精度动漫电影关键视觉。一位冷酷、忧郁的少女处于强风或高速运动之中，采用近距离半身构图，身体从画面左下斜向右上，脸部位于中上部偏右，以三分之二侧脸望向画面右方。人物神情冷静、坚定而略带疏离感，眼睛是全画面唯一的绝对焦点。
人物的长发、细发丝、衣带和轻盈装饰被风扬起，围绕脸部形成优雅而复杂的螺旋曲线。部分发丝从前景掠过，但不得遮挡眼睛和主要面部轮廓。发丝与衣带从画面边缘进入并延伸出画面，形成由左下向右上推进、再环绕回人物眼睛的 S 形视觉路径。人物身体、视线方向与反向飞舞的发丝产生动态对抗，使画面充满即将爆发的张力。
前景有数片被大幅虚化的【落叶／羽毛／花瓣／碎片】，从四周边缘切入，形成自然框景；中景人物面部和眼睛极度清晰；背景简洁柔和，具有明显的前、中、后三层景深。采用不完全居中的大胆裁切，人物头发、肩部和飘带部分超出画面边缘，制造动作仍在继续的瞬间感。
整体画面约85%为高反差黑白灰：银白头发、灰阶皮肤、深黑服装和柔和灰色背景，保留丰富的深黑、中灰与高光白层次。只有眼睛、反光表面和少量装饰保留高饱和色彩。瞳孔呈现青蓝、钴蓝、洋红与紫色交织的虹彩机械纹理；【眼镜镜片／眼睛／刀刃／首饰】反射鲜艳的蓝天与白云，并出现细微的棱镜色散。彩色面积严格克制，只集中在视觉焦点附近，形成黑白主体与局部高饱和彩色之间的强烈面积对比和饱和度对比。
精致日系动画线稿，锐利睫毛和眼部细节，干净赛璐璐明暗结合电影级厚涂光影，轻微胶片颗粒、镜头辉光和克制的色差边缘。画面流动、梦幻、冷艳、华丽但不杂乱，无文字，无Logo，无水印。
prompt.en:
High-Precision Anime Cinematic Key Visual.
A cold, melancholic young girl amid strong wind or high-speed motion, framed as a close mid-shot, her body angled diagonally from bottom-left to top-right, face positioned in the upper-center-right area, gazing with a two-thirds profile toward the right side of the frame. Her expression is calm, resolute, and slightly aloof; her eyes are the sole absolute focal point of the entire frame.

Her long hair, fine strands, sash, and light ornaments are lifted by the wind, curling around her face in elegant, intricate spiral curves. Some strands sweep across the foreground, but must not obscure the eyes or the main facial contours. Hair strands and sashes enter from the edges of the frame and extend beyond it, forming an S-shaped visual path that pushes from bottom-left toward top-right, then loops back around to the character's eyes. Her body, line of gaze, and the wind-blown hair flowing in the opposite direction create a dynamic tension, filling the frame with imminent explosive energy.

In the foreground, several heavily blurred 【fallen leaves / feathers / petals / fragments】 cut in from the surrounding edges, forming a natural framing; in the mid-ground, the character's face and eyes are extremely sharp; the background is simple and soft, with clear three-layer depth of field (foreground, mid-ground, background). An off-center, bold crop is used, with the girl's hair, shoulders, and trailing ribbons extending beyond the frame edges, creating a sense of action still in motion.

The overall frame is approximately 85% high-contrast black-and-white-gray: silver-white hair, gray-scale skin, deep black costume, and soft gray background, retaining rich layers of deep black, mid-gray, and bright highlight white. Only the eyes, reflective surfaces, and a few ornaments retain high-saturation color. The pupils display iridescent mechanical texture interweaving cyan-blue, cobalt blue, magenta, and purple; 【glasses lenses / eyes / blades / jewelry】 reflect vivid blue skies and clouds, with subtle prismatic dispersion. Color areas are strictly restrained, concentrated only near the visual focal point, creating a strong contrast in area and saturation between the black-and-white subject and the locally high-saturation color.

Refined Japanese anime linework, sharp lashes and eye details, clean cel shading combined with cinematic-grade thick-paint lighting, subtle film grain, lens flare, and restrained chromatic aberration at the edges. The image is fluid, dreamlike, cool and elegant, gorgeous yet not cluttered—no text, no logo, no watermark.

prompt.zh:
【成片形态——最高优先级】
15秒、16:9、一镜到底连续长镜头，写实国风仙侠CG，节奏舒缓有氛围。
严禁硬切、跳切、切镜头、分镜蒙太奇、场景切换、闪黑转场。
参考图K1、K3、K5只是同一条连续镜头内不同时刻的姿态锚点，不是三个独立镜头。
镜头路径必须连续：中远景缓慢推近→中近景→轻柔跟手与花瓣→平稳拉远收束，斯坦尼康一镜完成。

【开场锁定——必须从K1开始】
视频第0秒第一帧必须严格对齐参考图K1：黑发、水中石台盘腿打坐、闭目忧伤、雪梅雾境中远景。
禁止以接花、近景脸、白发状态开场。必须先完整建立K1中远景，再缓慢推近。

【角色】
慕沛灵（《凡人修仙传》），落云宗女修，心魔劫幻境。因对韩立思念与爱而不得，执念成劫。面容身份全程同一人，禁止换脸。

【发色时间线——严格执行】
- 0–11秒（含推近与接花全过程）：头发全程乌黑，禁止变白、禁止发梢染霜、禁止灰白中间态。
- 仅约11–13秒拉远过程中，黑发连续染成全白（全片仅此一次变白）。
- 13–15秒：必须满头银白长发，不要残留大片黑发。
- 禁止多次变白、禁止黑白反复切换。

【参考图用途】
- K1：开场第0秒中远景起点——黑发、水中石台盘腿、闭目忧伤。
- K3：约7–11秒接花时刻——黑发、单手掌心接细小花瓣、目光看花、服饰材质与裙摆贴石贴水；仍全黑发。
- K5：约13–15秒收束——全白发、仰望、极淡释怀、闭嘴。
中间推近睁眼（约4–7秒）与白发叹息态（约11–13秒）用文字描述连续演到，不要切镜。

【环境】
雪中桃花、浅水石台、薄雾、侧逆光。红裙与石台/水面真实接触有重量，禁止悬空。

【花瓣与雪——自然物理】
细雪：全片轻缓，从侧上方飘入。
粉白花瓣：小、稀疏；从画面外上方偏一侧斜向飘入，不是正上方倾倒；慢速、有空气阻力、微翻转与风偏。
接花段（约7–11秒，黑发）：
1) 先有自然抬手，手臂不要僵死固定；
2) 一片细小花瓣从侧上方自然飘落并落入掌心；
3) 花瓣在掌心停留约0.5–1秒；
4) 微风再吹离，飘向裙边石面/水面；
5) 接住后手臂可轻微放松/略放下；
6) 眼神始终跟随该花瓣。

【头发与风】
持续轻风。头顶不油腻；被风吹起的发丝发丝分明、单丝分离、轻盈飘动，禁止粘连成条。白发阶段同样清晰飘舞。

【眼泪】
若有泪意：眼眶湿润或极缓慢自然泪光，禁止脸上静态泪珠贴图。

【镜头时间线——一条连续镜头】
0–4s：必须从K1中远景起幅，缓慢推近；黑发；闭目→将睁；花瓣侧上斜落。
4–7s：连续推至中近景；黑发全黑；缓缓睁眼，神情忧伤（可眼眶湿润）；禁止切镜。
7–11s：继续贴近呈现K3接花；黑发仍全黑；花瓣入掌短暂停驻再吹走；手臂自然起落；禁止切镜。
11–13s：同一镜头平稳拉远；此阶段头发连续变为全白；抬头、轻叹、闭嘴；禁止切镜。
13–15s：落幅到K5态；全白发；极含蓄释怀；闭嘴无口型。

【声音——成片必须完全静音，方便后期BGM】
- 绝对不要BGM、配乐、旋律乐器。
- 绝对不要对白、旁白、人声。
- 绝对不要环境音、风声、雪声、水声、衣料声等任何音效。
- 输出视频保持完全静音（无音轨或静音），以便后期单独叠加BGM。
- 宁可全静音，也不要加入任何声音。

【硬约束总表】
1) 第0秒必须是K1中远景起幅。
2) 一镜到底，禁止硬切。
3) 0–11秒全黑发；仅11秒后一次变白；结尾全白。
4) 花瓣斜落入掌、停驻、再吹走；手臂自然。
5) 发丝分明；泪不静态贴脸。
6) 题字小、飘逸、无句号、浮现、逐字正确；发丝可压字。
7) 全片完全静音；不要片头片尾纯黑场。
prompt.en:
【Shot form — highest priority】
A 15-second, 16:9, single continuous long take, photoreal Chinese xianxia cinematic CG, slow atmospheric pacing.
Hard cuts, jump cuts, shot changes, montage, scene switches, and black flash transitions are strictly forbidden.
References K1, K3, and K5 are pose anchors inside ONE continuous shot, not three separate shots.
Camera path: slow push-in from medium-wide → medium close-up → gentle follow on hand and petal → smooth pull-back. Steadicam one-take.

【Opening lock — must start from K1】
Frame 0 must strictly match K1: black hair, lotus on a stone in shallow water, eyes closed in sorrow, snowy peach-blossom mist, medium-wide.
Do not open on petal-catching, face close-up, or white hair. Fully establish K1, then slowly push in.

【Character】
Mu Peiling (A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality), Luoyun Sect cultivator, heart-demon vision from longing for Han Li. Same face throughout; no face swap.

【Hair color timeline — strict】
- 0–11s (including push-in and petal catch): fully jet-black; no whitening, no frosted tips.
- Only ~11–13s pull-back: hair continuously becomes fully silver-white (once only).
- 13–15s: full silver-white hair.
- No multiple whitening events.

【References】
- K1: opening at 0s — black hair, lotus on waterside stone, eyes closed.
- K3: ~7–11s petal moment — black hair, open palm catches tiny petal, eyes on petal; still black hair.
- K5: ~13–15s ending — full white hair, upward gaze, subtle relief, lips closed.
Mid eye-open sorrow (~4–7s) and white-hair sigh (~11–13s) via continuous performance only; no cut.

【Environment】
Snowy peach blossoms, shallow water, flat stone, soft mist, side light. Dress has real weight on stone/water; no floating cloth.

【Petals and snow】
Fine snow throughout from upper side.
Small sparse petals enter from outside frame at upper side angle (not center zenith); slow fall with air resistance.
Petal catch (~7–11s, black hair): natural arm raise → one tiny petal lands in palm → rests 0.5–1s → breeze blows it away → arm slightly relaxes; eyes always track the petal.

【Hair and wind】
Gentle wind; clean non-greasy hair; wind-blown strands as separate filaments, not clumped. Same for white hair.

【Tears】
Moist eyes or very slow natural tearlight only; no static glued tear stickers.

【Timeline — one continuous shot】
0–4s: start on K1 medium-wide, slow push-in; black hair; eyes closed → about to open.
4–7s: push to medium close-up; fully black hair; slowly open eyes, sorrowful; no cut.
7–11s: closer for K3 petal catch; still black hair; petal lands, brief rest, blown away; natural arm motion; no cut.
11–13s: same shot pulls back; hair turns fully white; lift face, soft sigh, lips closed; no cut.
13–15s: settle into K5; full white hair; subtle relief; lips closed, no mouth acting.

【Audio — full silence for your manual BGM】
No BGM, score, dialogue, voice-over, ambience, wind, snow, water, or any SFX.
Output completely silent so you can add BGM later yourself.
If unsure: total silence only.

【Hard constraints】
1) Frame 0 = K1 medium-wide.
2) Single continuous take; no hard cuts.
3) Black hair until 11s; one whitening after 11s; ending fully white.
4) Petal: side-fall, into palm, brief rest, blow away; natural arm.
5) Separate hair strands; no static tears.
6) Small elegant calligraphy, no period, fade-in, exact Chinese text; hair can cover text.
7) Completely silent; no pure-black open/close.
